metadata.title: Cooking Elephant Apple | Ou Tenga
metadata.description: Ou Tenga, also known as elephant apple, holds a cherished place in Assam's cuisine. This fruit, with its tangy and slightly sour flavor, adds a unique zest to various dishes, particularly in Assamese cuisine. It is commonly used in traditional dishes like fish curries, chutneys, pickles, and lentil soups, imparting a refreshing acidity that enhances the overall flavor profile. The versatility of Ou Tenga makes it a beloved ingredient among Assamese households, where it is celebrated for its culinary contributions and cultural significance. Whether enjoyed in a spicy chutney or as a souring agent in a savory curry, Ou Tenga remains an essential and much-loved element in Assam's rich and diverse gastronomic heritage.
